Subject: Request to Add New Languages to the Platform

Hi Team,

Please add the English language (code `en`) as the primary language for our upcoming release. In addition, the following language codes should be included in the batch update: `en,de,fr`. Let me know once these have been integrated so we can proceed with the localization testing.
